reviewer: Codex source-research agent; machine visual review
scope: Compare all 18 supplementary OSM route numbers, gross positions and directions in the generated overview with the club-linked whole-course guide. No geometry adoption or independent human approval.

sources.accuracy: Ungeoreferenced illustrative guide; no metric accuracy adopted
sources.rights: Local reference only; no distribution or derivative-geometry grant found

reviewImage.toolchain: PyMuPDF 1.28.2, SVG converted to PDF and rendered at scale 1

holes.observation: Central route plays south/southeast toward the maintenance-building area.
Long southeastern corridor plays toward the southern extremity.
Short southeastern return plays northwest beside hole 2.
Eastern central corridor returns northwest toward the clubhouse.
West of the range, route plays southwest then bends west.
Short lower-central route plays southeast beside the range.
From the southwest edge, route returns northeast.
Short route plays southwest toward the kiosk and hole-10 start area.
Long western corridor plays north, matching the guide's turn into the back nine.
Short far-western route plays north toward the northwestern extremity.
From the northwestern extremity, route plays east/southeast.
Middle western back-nine corridor reverses toward west/northwest.
Lower western back-nine corridor returns east/southeast.
Route east of the central road plays north/northeast.
Short companion route to hole 15 plays south.
Lower eastern arm returns west toward the clubhouse.

limitations: This is a qualitative whole-course comparison, not map registration. No controls, metric residuals or geometric accuracy were established.
Guide publication/capture epoch is unknown. Several 2024–2026 course changes are documented separately in the research dossier.
Exact tee colors, dedicated tee pads, pins, green boundaries, landing geometry and route lengths remain unapproved.
Only 15 green features, 19 tee areas, five fairways and 13 bunkers exist in the supplementary OSM intake; missing features were not supplied by this review.
Rear-nine orange distances on the official card do not establish physical tee positions; those markers are absent from the hole guides.
Independent per-hole comparisons with dated licensed imagery and appropriate control evidence remain required before production geometry adoption.
